roleContext.jobDescription: The payments authorisation service approves or declines the bank's card transactions in real time. The Lead Engineer is the technical lead of the authorisation team: owns the service's technical roadmap, signs the design reviews for changes to the authorisation path, leads the incident reviews for authorisation outages, and mentors the team's engineers. The bank requires prior experience as technical lead of a real-time payments or comparable transaction service, with at least six years of software engineering, and the bank's secure development certification for the payments domain. Reports to the head of payments engineering; works with the fraud team, the card scheme liaison and the platform SRE group.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Lead Engineer, Payments Authorisation Service

## Experience

- Lead Engineer and technical lead of the card authorisation service at a retail bank since 2022, signing the design reviews for changes to the authorisation path; software engineer and senior software engineer on the same service from 2017 to 2022; eight years of software engineering in all.
- Secure development certification for the payments domain held since 2021 under the bank's secure development programme, renewed 2024; certificate available in the bank's learning record.
- Led the incident reviews for the four authorisation outages of the last three years under the payments incident review process, with the review reports in the incident register.
- Owner of the service's technical roadmap since 2022, reviewed with the head of payments engineering each quarter.
- Mentored the team's six engineers under the engineering mentoring scheme and wrote the boundary note of each signed design review, stating what the review did not cover.

## Work samples

- Work sample: two signed design reviews with their boundary notes, one incident review report and the certification record extract, with the incident register and design repository references as a verification trail.
